planning_floors.production_duration_rule: Additive to event completeness and separately frozen natural-time obligations; elapsed time alone never passes.
planning_floors.production_continuation_rule: At least ceil(N/3), and at least seven distinct cohort roots, complete Worker-to-Sol-to-Worker continuation.
planning_floors.production_overlap_rule: N >= 20 in a substantive predeclared overlap window covering real cohort work, not an instantaneous peak.

data_contract_before_measurement: Freeze work-class/provider/realm/resource strata and independence taxonomy; sparse strata remain unqualified.
Freeze exact canonical timestamp and identity fields for all six applicable edges, source/config versions and permissible contribution per root.
Report all eligible starts with completed, active, right-censored, missing, invalid and failed states; do not discard failed or unresolved starts.
Report raw nearest-rank quantiles, pooled and root-weighted results, root contributions and uncertainty; repeated turns are not independent roots.
Use comparable canonical occurrence clocks; invalid clocks or absent endpoints remain unavailable.
No completed-only p95 or max pass while censored observations could breach the budget.
Freeze ordinary and deliberate-fault strata and recovery limits in advance; all are retained in authority, recovery and Chairman-touch denominators.

fairness_planning_rule.evidence: Canonical candidate, allocation and policy receipts for equal priority/weight, resource/capability requirements and eligible-realm set.
fairness_planning_rule.age: Report global oldest eligible age and per-comparable-class age. Preserve root age across retry/backoff; pause only verified predeclared ineligibility.
fairness_planning_rule.wait_budget: Literal eligible-capacity maximum is not frozen. Emitting WAITING_CAPACITY does not end the wait.
fairness_planning_rule.policy_effect: Measurement of the existing scheduler only; no scheduler modification or invented guarantee.
